name: BASC 56 - Bay Area Side Events Day 2024
information: BASC is proud to host a competition in San Jose again! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin' featuring a variety of unofficial events. The main focus of this competition will be its unofficial events, which are not sanctioned by the WCA. For more details and unofficial events registration, see the [Unofficial Events tab](#35589-must-read-unofficial-events). ## This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube. ## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. We will be using Cubing Contests for live results for the unofficial events at this competition. See the [Live Results tab](#35619-live-results) for more information. Competition day timing: * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Lunch will end at the scheduled time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. If you like big cubes and blindfolded solving, check out [BASC 57 - Big and Blind 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC57BigandBlind2024), a competition taking place in San Jose the same weekend as this one!
